route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour and Skills)

fees.what: Issuance of a work permit for a foreigner

permit.validityNote: Given for a specific type of work for three years and renewed every year; the Ministry may vary the three-year limit (Labour Proclamation 1156/2019, art. 176(2)).
permit.feesNote: Council of Ministers Regulation No. 394/2016 (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 6, 12 December 2016), issued under the 2003 Labour Proclamation; Regulation 573/2025 sets fees for overseas employment services only and doesn't replace it. No later work-permit fee regulation was found.

sources.title: UNHCR RIMAP, Ethiopia: Labour Proclamation No. 1156/2019, selected provisions
sources.said: Article 176(1) Employment of Foreign Nationals Any foreigner may only be employed in any type of work in Ethiopia where he possesses a work permit given to him by the Ministry.

sources.title: FAOLEX, Labour Proclamation No. 1156/2019 (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 89, 5 September 2019), art. 176
sources.said: any foreigner may only be employed in any type of work in Ethiopia where he possesses a work permit given to him by the Ministry. … a work permit shall be given for an employment in a specific type of work for three years and shall be renewed every year; provided, however, that the Ministry may vary the three years limit as required.

sources.title: Council of Ministers Regulation No. 394/2016 to provide for the determination of fees for work permit, private employment agency license and approval of contract of employment (Federal Negarit Gazette No. 6, 12 December 2016), schedule; scan of the Gazette hosted by MetaAppz's Ethiopian Federal Laws
